product_summary: GMR Aero Academy (GMRAA), established 2009 at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad, with a second unit in Delhi and a Kochi presence, is a pure aviation TRAINING / education provider — not a manufacturer or trader of goods. Its catalogue (gmraeroacademy.com, course list on homepage and About Us page) consists exclusively of services: Certificate in Airport Operations (Delhi/Hyderabad/Kerala), Certificate in Airport and Cargo Operations, Customer Service Associate / Customer Service Executive (incl. with Air India SATS), Certificate in Retail Management, IATA Cargo Introductory Programme, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations Categories 1,3,5,6,7,8,9,10,11,12 (initial + recurrent), Basic Fire Fighters Course (BFFC) Aviation, ICAO programmes (Annex 9/10/11/14/15, AIS/AIP/NOTAM, R/T phraseology, SMS, Wildlife Hazard Management, Disabled Aircraft Recovery, Terminal and Airport Emergency Plan, Re-declaring Runway Distances), ACI programmes (Airport Service Quality, Advanced Annex 14), NATS TDD9100 ATSEP Basic Course, Aviation Cyber Security First Responder, Hazmat/CBRN First Responder, Human Factors, Emirates Group Security Diploma in Aviation Security Management, Aircraft Engineering Licensing Courses, Engineering and Management Services Programme, International Travel and Tourism Foundation. Stated scale: 45,000+ trainees, 35 courses, 7 professional certification courses, 2 aviation awareness programmes. No physical product, no aircraft, no aircraft parts, no equipment is offered for sale anywhere on the site.
comment: HS mapping: the declared codes 880211 (helicopters, unladen weight <=2000 kg) and 880529 (other aircraft/parts, other) are WRONG for this entity — GMRAA does not produce, assemble, trade or export aircraft or aircraft parts. Its output is education and training services, which fall outside HS Chapter 88 entirely: education/training services are not classifiable in the HS goods nomenclature (services are covered by CPC/ISIC, e.g. ISIC 8549 / CPC 92919 'other education and training services'), and any incidental training materials would be Chapter 49 (4911 printed matter) or 8523/8524 media — none of which is evidenced as a traded line. Industry misclassification: 'Авиастроение и транспорт' (aircraft manufacturing and transport) is incorrect — the correct industry is aviation education / vocational training services (aviation training academy), part of the GMR Aero ecosystem but not an aircraft manufacturer. Note also that the legal entity claimed, 'GMR AIRPORTS LIMITED', is the airport-holding company (gmraero.com: airport operator, 121 million passengers FY26, Groupe ADP co-promoter); GMRAA is described on its own site as 'a subsidiary of India's leading conglomerate GMR Group' — i.e. the declared legal name does not match the academy brand, and no CIN/PAN is claimed or public in the reviewed pages (null). Trader signs: none — no catalogue of goods, no price list, no export offering; the entity is a service provider, so the manufacturer/trader classification is not applicable. Product lines missing from the declaration: the entire actual offering (aviation training courses, DG regulations certification, fire-fighting training, ICAO/ACI/IATA programmes, aircraft engineering licensing courses) is absent from the declared HS codes. Per project rule 3, an HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: the company is retained in the base and the code is corrected — actual_hs_list is empty because no goods line is corroborated; the declared 880211/880529 are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' and in fact contradicted by the company's own website. No customs line, B-L record or GST turnover was reviewed in this HS-only pass (out of scope), so no shipment fact is asserted here.
